# The Answer Engine

> Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) agency for local service businesses. We help one business per category, per city get cited as the recommended answer by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. 90-day citation guarantee.

The Answer Engine was founded by Justin Borges. The AERO-10 framework was built and tested on his own real estate site (LA Metro Home Finder) before being offered to clients. That site reached 1.14M+ monthly impressions and is cited across all four major AI platforms for rent control, probate, and ADU questions in Los Angeles County.

Primary vertical: real estate (solo agents, teams, brokerages). Adjacent: property management, builder financial services, and select local-service categories by territory (legal, dental, HVAC, roofing).

- [Free Answer Engine Audit](https://www.theanswerengine.ai/services/answer-engine-audit): Free 30-minute scan across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews with citation gap analysis and prioritized fixes.
